def count_short_name_low_value(names, values):
    """Report the number of catalogued articles qualifying for the
    short-label, low-value register of an inventory ledger.

    In the stockroom accounting practice for which this routine is
    prepared, every article held on the premises is entered into the
    ledger under two particulars: an identifying label, recorded as a
    string, and an appraised worth, recorded as a whole number of
    accounting units. These particulars are furnished to the present
    function as two parallel sequences. names is a list of strings and
    values is a list of ints of the same length; names[i] and values[i]
    describe the same item.

    The occasion for this computation is the periodic stocktaking
    exercise, during which the responsible clerk is directed to single
    out a particular class of holdings, namely those articles carrying
    both an abbreviated label and a modest appraisal. Such articles are
    grouped for administrative convenience into a subsidiary register,
    and the ledger office requires only their number, not their
    identities. The governing criterion is stated as follows. Count the
    items whose name has at most 3 characters AND whose value is
    strictly less than 10.

    The figure so obtained constitutes the sole output of the function
    and is forwarded without alteration to the stocktaking report. The
    worked examples below record the expected results for an empty
    ledger and for a representative consignment of mixed holdings.

    Examples:

    >>> count_short_name_low_value([], [])
    0
    >>> count_short_name_low_value(['ax', 'fig', 'bolt', 'fig', 'eel', 'refill', 'fig', 'bolt'], [17, -1, 11, 5, 36, 34, 35, 21])
    2
    """
